'''Hosts''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Crude Parasites|Crude]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Human]] or an [[Assimilated Villager]] kills 5 skeletons.
* Spawns in groups of 1 to 2, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 3|Phase 3]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 5.
* If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Herd]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Hosts are Burrowing Melee/Ranged/Summoner hybrids. They can move only when underground and are incapable of movement when on the surface. 

While moving underground, they will release [[Residue]].

* Their Melee Attack, performed by slamming their large tentacles, inflicts knockback and AoE Damage.
* Their Ranged Attack is performed by them throwing a Bomb, which inflicts Poison, [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]], and [[Viral]] after exploding.
* They are able to perform summons, generating [[Rupter|Rupters]], while being underground.
* Hosts are able to generate Waves, small damaging areas of disturbed ground. After standing still for a brief period they will summon a Wave which homes toward the target at fast speed but is unable to move up blocks. Waves deal very high damage per second and ignore immunity frames.
** This is telegraphed by flame particles and a significantly louder and higher pitched growl.
* They are able to teleport while underground, but the following conditions must be met:
** There must be 3 blocks below its current position, and in the position where it will teleport to.
** Those 3 blocks, in both positions, need to be full blocks.
** The sum of the 3 blocks' [[Hardness|hardness]] values must be less than <u>10</u>.
* If a Host gets 40 kills, it will evolve into a [[Herd]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Hosts, like any other [[:Category:Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled. 
* Hosts, while moving underground, upon coming in contact with Magma Blocks they will be hurt.
